about.en: ARGUS is the token of Argus, a token launchpad on Arc, Circle's stablecoin-focused layer 1, where users create, discover and trade launchpad tokens priced in USDC. Argus keeps a share of launch fees and directs 80% of its revenue to buying back ARGUS. It is the token at 0xeCe5cA8bf9220718E5727754026757512212cb3c on Arc; it is unrelated to the older Argus (argusnetwork.co) and to Argus Foundation on Solana.
